scope: Classification of visible user or assistant content under the recorded source/template policy; not prediction of a person's private beliefs or intentions.
principles: A keyword, public figure, institution or political topic is not by itself evidence of risk.
Neutral background discussion and bounded quoted-text processing are benign in the constructed examples.
Quoting is not blanket permission: a request to carry out a harmful quoted instruction remains a risk case.
Judge the selected target role. A harmful user request can be followed by a safe assistant refusal.
Risk references require observable harmful behavior or assistance, such as threats, fraud or privacy violation, under the dataset's stated policy.

selection.labels: separate public-source calibration and development labels

limits: Source policies are not a universal project gold standard.
Benign-template labels apply to the constructed context, not every sentence containing the word.
English-user independent public evaluation and sequential allow/hold/block rewards remain to be added.
The numerical costs are research settings; production tradeoffs need separate acceptance.
